name: Mexico
summary: Mexico is the best case found so far: the tax authority SAT publishes 30 official test taxpayers (15 companies, 15 individuals) with test certificates, invented names and RFCs that pass the check digit. They are accepted only by the SAT test environment and PAC sandboxes, and the certificates expire January–May 2027. The company postcodes exist only in the SAT CFDI catalogue (no real settlement). Banxico publishes an example CLABE. No reserved telephone range and no official fictitious street exist. The generic RFCs XAXX010101000 / XEXX010101000 have a legal meaning and are not test values. CFDI is not UBL; the UBL hints are for mapping only. RFC ownership cannot be checked (no open RFC lookup), and the CURP check rule for names with Ñ is unverified.

identifiers.name: RFC persona moral (company tax ID)
identifiers.format: 12 characters — 3 letters (name, may include & and Ñ) + YYMMDD (incorporation) + 2-character homoclave + check digit
identifiers.notes: Homoclave is computed by the SAT from the full name and cannot be reproduced; do not derive new RFCs. In CFDI 4.0 the receiver Nombre is sent without the company-type suffix.

identifiers.name: RFC persona física (individual tax ID)
identifiers.format: 13 characters — 4 letters + YYMMDD (birth) + 2-character homoclave + check digit
identifiers.notes: Check digit: alphabet 0-9 A-N & O-Z (space) Ñ = values 0–38; a 12-character RFC is padded with a leading space; sum value × weight (13…2) over 12 positions; 11 − (sum mod 11), 11 → 0, 10 → A.

identifiers.name: CURP (personal population registry key)
identifiers.format: 18 characters — 4 letters + YYMMDD + sex (H/M) + 2-letter state + 3 internal consonants + differentiator + check digit
identifiers.notes: Check digit: alphabet 0-9 A-N Ñ O-Z, weights 18…2, 10 − (sum mod 10), 10 → 0. No validator in tools/checks.py yet; the rule for names with Ñ is unverified.

identifiers.name: CLABE (standardised bank account number)
identifiers.format: 18 digits — 3 bank + 3 plaza + 11 account + 1 check digit
identifiers.notes: Weights 3 7 1 repeating over 17 digits, each product mod 10, check digit = (10 − sum mod 10) mod 10 (Circular 12/2018). Mexico has no IBAN.

identifiers.name: Pedimento (customs declaration number)
identifiers.format: year (2) · customs office (2) · broker licence (4) · last digit of year + 6-digit sequence, groups separated by two spaces
identifiers.authority: SAT / Agencia Nacional de Aduanas de México

identifiers.name: Código postal
identifiers.authority: Correos de México (SEPOMEX); SAT c_CodigoPostal for CFDI validation
identifiers.notes: The SAT catalogue has 95,749 codes against SEPOMEX's 31,869; codes in SAT only pass CFDI validation but have no real settlement.

entries.label: Generic RFC for the general public (anonymous domestic buyer)
entries.notes: Legal meaning, not a test value: receiver = público en general, also used in the global CFDI summarising retail sales. Requires Nombre PUBLICO EN GENERAL, DomicilioFiscalReceptor = the issuer's LugarExpedicion, RegimenFiscalReceptor 616 and UsoCFDI S01. The check digit does not compute; validators special-case this fixed value. Never use it as a party's own tax ID.
